replacements.instruction: Do not write W/(W+L)-style formulas in reader-facing manuscript text; make CI fail if one is introduced.
replacements.before: We report each system contrast as wins/losses/ties (W/L/T) for the first-named system and compute its win rate over non-tied order-consistent comparisons as $W/(W+L)$.
replacements.after: We report each system contrast as wins/losses/ties (W/L/T) for the first-named system and compute the win rate over non-tied order-consistent comparisons.
